intent.statement: Deterministically replace every header, footer, noise, separator, and heading AI Cleanup block with exactly two newline characters while retaining story text in source order.

examples: First paragraph. and Second paragraph. returned as separate story blocks restore the omitted canonical double newline between them.
spec_items.statement: Every response block must match an exact non-overlapping forward canonical-source slice, and every omitted source gap must contain only whitespace that is restored exactly into reconstructed output.

examples: A low-confidence heading and a high-confidence noise block each contribute exactly two LF characters in response order.
spec_items.statement: AI Cleanup emits exact story slices unchanged and deterministically emits exactly two LF characters for every header, footer, noise, separator, or heading block regardless of confidence.

examples: Adjacent non-story blocks retain two LF characters per block and an old checkpoint restarts at window one.
spec_items.statement: Final cleaned-text assembly preserves restored canonical whitespace and deterministic artifact separators without trimming or collapsing them, and checkpoints use a new internal fingerprint that rejects prior reconstruction state.

examples: Header, Story, Separator, Heading, Footer, and Noise render as Story followed by four LF characters; the header, footer, and noise contribute no output.
spec_items.statement: Superseding SPEC-AICR-002, AI Cleanup emits exact story slices unchanged, emits exactly two LF characters for each separator or heading block, and emits nothing for each header, footer, or noise block, regardless of confidence.
